outputs: defense against adversarial examples in text tasks
The paper focuses on defending models against adversarial attacks in text generation and classification tasks, including robustness in Large Language Models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks.

changes_made.explanation: The paper focuses on adversarial defense for text classification tasks, not natural language generation. All metadata related to NLG tasks has been removed.
Normalized metric names by removing percentage symbols and simplifying to base forms.
No LLMs are used as judges for evaluation; the paper does not use post-generation LLM assessment.
No human evaluation is conducted in the paper.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on adversarial defense for text classification, not natural language generation. The extracted metadata incorrectly identified it as addressing NLG tasks. The automatic metrics used are for evaluating defense robustness in classification tasks.
